summary: Frontend-only validation of 5 coach dashboard changes (Super Admin juegolaureado@gmail.com). RESULTS: F1 UUID-free model names PASS (sidebar shows 'ATR (Issurin)' / 'Ondulada Avanzada (Zourdos)', PLAN ACTIVO card has no UUID). F5 Duración y Actividad labels '(min)' PASS. F2 active-plan-card → period-overview FAIL (no navigation; OLD tabs Resumen/Periodización/Carga still visible; active-plan-card stuck on 'Sin plan seleccionado' even after plan selected). F3 Export PDF modal with 'Tarjetas del Panel' FAIL: only export button found is data-testid='header-master-report-btn' which opens the SESSIONS export modal (master-report-modal), NOT the ControlPanel PDF report modal with checkboxes export-card-readiness/acwr/active_plan/my_plans/athletes/events/sessions/exercises/adherence (ALL ABSENT from DOM) and no 'Descargar PDF' button (has 'PDF combinado'). Modal bg IS white. F4 Sessions capacity-select NOT TESTABLE — Sessions module not reachable: subnavs under tab-datos only expose subnav-graphic-plan, subnav-calendar-view, subnav-smart-alerts. No 'Sesiones' section-tab and no capacity-select-* elements found.

ui_bugs.issue: active-plan-card shows 'Sin plan seleccionado' even after selecting a plan via sidebar (sidebar-plan-8b945365 Judo plan). The active plan reference does not update the panel tile.

Clicking active-plan-card does NOT call onNavigate('datos','period-overview'). URL stays at /dashboard, [data-testid='period-overview'] is not in the DOM, and the OLD training-system tabs ('Resumen','Periodización','Carga') remain visible. Expected: open Datos > Periodización > period-overview section.

ui_bugs.component: ControlPanel — Export PDF modal trigger button MISSING
ui_bugs.issue: The header has only [data-testid='header-master-report-btn'] (opens 'Exportar Sesiones' / master-report-modal) and [data-testid='export-alerts-pdf-btn']. The Control Panel PDF export button (that opens the modal containing export-card-* checkboxes and 'Descargar PDF') is not findable in the Panel UI. As a result the new 'Tarjetas del Panel' section with checkboxes cannot be reached by users.

When the (sessions) report modal opens, none of the 9 expected export-card-* testids are present: readiness, acwr, active_plan, my_plans, athletes, events, sessions, exercises, adherence. Likely the panel-export modal in ControlPanel.js (line 1953) is implemented but its trigger is not wired into the visible UI.

Inside tab-datos, no subnav exposes Sesiones/SessionEditor (only subnav-graphic-plan, subnav-calendar-view, subnav-smart-alerts). No capacity-select-* element in DOM; cannot validate CAPACITY_CONFIG (Psicológica/Teórica options), automatic unidadVolumen change, nor window.confirm dialog.

integration_issues.flow: Select sidebar plan → PLAN ACTIVO card update
integration_issues.issue: Selecting a plan from sidebar-plan-* does not propagate to active-plan-card (still 'Sin plan seleccionado'). Probable: activePlan state vs selectedPlan state are different in ControlPanel.

onClick handler on active-plan-card does not call onNavigate('datos','period-overview'); old training-system tabs remain visible. Probable cause: the handler depends on activePlan != null, which is false because the card is in 'Sin plan seleccionado' state.

The wiring between the Panel UI and ControlPanel.js's export-card-* DialogContent appears broken — the dialog is never shown because no button mounts it. Need to expose the trigger (e.g. a 'Exportar Reporte PDF' button with data-testid='export-pdf-btn' inside the Panel).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Update ControlPanel.js so active-plan-card reflects the currently selected plan (PLAN ACTIVO label should not stay at 'Sin plan seleccionado' once a sidebar plan is selected). Verify selectedPlan/activePlan store synchronization.

FIX (HIGH): Wire active-plan-card onClick to onNavigate('datos','period-overview'). Ensure the navigation is triggered even when activePlan was resolved from sidebar selection. Verify it lands on section-tab-visualizacion > period-overview (not the old Resumen/Periodizacion/Evaluaciones/Carga/Control tabs).

FIX (HIGH): Expose the 'Exportar Reporte PDF' trigger button inside the Panel (data-testid='export-pdf-btn' or similar) that opens the ControlPanel.js DialogContent with bg-white + export-card-* checkboxes + 'Descargar PDF'. Currently the only PDF entry in the header opens the master-report-modal (sessions export), so the new panel PDF flow is unreachable by users.

FIX (HIGH): Surface the Sesiones / SessionEditor module under tab-datos (e.g. a 'subnav-sessions' or 'section-tab-sesiones'). Without it the new CAPACITY_CONFIG (Psicológica/Teórica) and capacity→unidadVolumen auto-change with window.confirm cannot be reached from the dashboard.
(LOW) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to remove the recurring 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' console warnings (still present).
critical_code_review_comments: ControlPanel.js line 1190: data-testid='active-plan-card' is present, but its handler does not appear to fire navigation when the PLAN ACTIVO tile shows 'Sin plan seleccionado'. Make the click always navigate, or hide the tile when no plan is selected to avoid confusing UX.

ControlPanel.js line 1953: data-testid={`export-card-${card.key}`} exists in code but the parent DialogContent is not opened by any visible button. Either bind it to an existing button or add a new 'Exportar Reporte PDF' button with a clear data-testid.

SessionEditor.js line 1137: capacity-select-* testid exists, but the SessionEditor itself is not mounted under any subnav of tab-datos for the active plan, making the new behaviour invisible to users.

success_rate.frontend: 40% — PASS: F1 (UUID-free names in sidebar & active-plan-card text), F5 (Duración y Actividad '(min)' labels). FAIL: F2 (no navigation, old tabs visible, active-plan-card stuck on 'Sin plan seleccionado'), F3 (panel export PDF modal unreachable — only sessions export modal opens; export-card-* DOM ABSENT, no 'Descargar PDF' btn). NOT_TESTABLE: F4 (Sessions module not reachable from UI; subnav for Sesiones missing).

seed_data_creation: None (no data modifications were made; only navigation and a click on active-plan-card which did not trigger any backend write).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login as super admin → click [data-testid='tab-planes'] → click [data-testid='sidebar-plan-25b9abc7...'] (Boxeo) or [data-testid='sidebar-plan-8b945365...'] (Judo). Esc to close drawer. Then [data-testid='tab-panel']. The available export buttons in header are only [data-testid='header-master-report-btn'] (sessions export) and [data-testid='export-alerts-pdf-btn']; the panel PDF export modal with export-card-* checkboxes is NOT currently opened by any visible button. Datos subnavs are only subnav-graphic-plan / subnav-calendar-view / subnav-smart-alerts (no Sesiones).
rca_of_the_issue: F2: active-plan-card click handler is likely gated by `if (activePlan)` while ControlPanel keeps showing 'Sin plan seleccionado' (selectedPlan from sidebar not propagated to activePlan state). Fix both the propagation AND ensure click always navigates. F3: The new DialogContent with bg-white + export-card-* checkboxes (ControlPanel.js line 1953) lacks an opener. Likely the developer added the modal JSX and the handleExportPDF flow, but didn't wire the trigger button into the Panel header. The existing header-master-report-btn opens a different, pre-existing 'Exportar Sesiones' modal (master-report-modal). F4: SessionEditor.js exists with capacity-select-* testids and updated CAPACITY_CONFIG, but no parent route/subnav exposes it from /dashboard > Datos. Need to add a subnav or section-tab to mount SessionEditor with a real plan/macrocycle context.
